errors.already-exists: A file or folder with that name already exists
errors.storage-full: Not enough disk space or quota left
errors.connection-refused: The host refused the connection — check the address and port, and that the service is running
errors.host-unreachable: The host is unreachable — check the address and your network connection
errors.connection-lost-resumable: The connection was lost — retry the transfer to continue where it stopped
errors.transfer-verify-failed: The copy didn't match the original, so it was discarded — retry to copy it again
errors.transfer-source-changed: The file kept changing while it was copied — retry once it has finished being written
errors.port-in-use: Port {{port}} and the ports after it are already in use ({{attempts}} tried)
errors.remote-forward-denied: The server refused the remote forward — the port may already be in use there, or forwarding is not allowed
errors.ssh-legacy-algorithms-required: The server only offers older algorithms that are off by default ({{offered}}). Turn on "Legacy Algorithms" for this host to connect.
errors.ssh-no-common-algorithm: The server only offers algorithms Voltius does not support: {{offered}}.
errors.ssh-password-rejected: Password authentication rejected — check the username and password
errors.ssh-password-expired: The server requires a new password — sign in once from a terminal and change it there
errors.ssh-prompt-unanswerable: The server asked "{{prompt}}", which can't be answered automatically
errors.ssh-no-usable-auth-method: No usable authentication method — the server only accepts: {{methods}}
errors.ssh-netbird-sso-required: This peer requires NetBird SSH sign-in.
errors.ssh-netbird-settings-invalid: This host's NetBird settings are incomplete. Enter an HTTPS issuer, a public client ID and a SHA256 host key fingerprint in its NetBird SSH settings.
errors.ssh-netbird-endpoint-origin: The identity provider's device or token endpoint isn't on the issuer's HTTPS origin, so Voltius won't sign in through it. Providers like Google can't be used.
errors.ssh-netbird-provider-unreachable: Couldn't reach the identity provider. Check your connection and the issuer URL.
errors.ssh-netbird-provider-error: The identity provider sent an unexpected response. Try again later.
errors.ssh-netbird-device-flow-declined: The identity provider declined device sign-in for this client ID. Ask your administrator to allow the device authorization grant.
errors.ssh-netbird-expired: The NetBird sign-in expired before it was approved. Try again.
errors.ssh-netbird-denied: The identity provider denied the NetBird sign-in.
errors.ssh-netbird-rejected: NetBird rejected this identity for the requested SSH user.
errors.ssh-netbird-auth-failed: NetBird SSH authentication failed or timed out. Try again.
errors.ssh-netbird-pin-mismatch: The peer's SSH host key {{fingerprint}} doesn't match the NetBird fingerprint saved for this host. Check the fingerprint with your administrator.
errors.ssh-auth-timeout: Authentication timed out after {{seconds}}s — the server accepted the connection but never answered. Some older SSH servers stall here; try the host's "Legacy Algorithms" option, or another authentication method.
errors.ssh-tailscale-check-denied: Tailscale didn't approve this SSH session. Check your Tailscale SSH policy, or try again and approve the browser check.
errors.ssh-tailscale-check-timeout: Tailscale SSH authentication did not finish within {{minutes}} minutes. Retry the connection.
errors.ssh-tailscale-check-required: Tailscale SSH needs a browser check for this host. Open a terminal to it, approve the check, then try again.
errors.login-rejected: The server rejected the username or password
errors.resource-locked: The file is locked on the server — someone else may have it open
errors.vault-sign-in-required: Team vaults require an active server connection. Sign in to continue.
errors.vault-read-only: You don't have write access to this vault. Ask a vault manager for a role that can make changes.
errors.vault-role-read-only: You don't have write access to this vault (your role: {{role}}). Only owners, managers, and editors can make changes.
errors.vault-permissions-unavailable: Unable to verify vault permissions because the keychain is unavailable. Try again.
errors.vault-permissions-corrupted: Vault permission data is corrupted. Sign in again to refresh access.
errors.knock-udp-via-proxy: UDP knocks can't go through a proxy. Use TCP steps or a direct connection for this host.
errors.device-file-access-off: File access is off on that device. Turn it on in Settings › Devices on the device.
errors.device-access-denied: The device declined the request to open its files.
errors.device-approval-timed-out: Nobody answered the request on the device in time.
errors.device-busy: That device has too many file sessions open. Close one and try again.
errors.device-unreachable: Can't reach that device. Check that it's on and on the same network.
errors.device-access-expired: Access to this device ended. Open it again to ask for permission.
errors.device-read-only: That device shares these folders read-only.
errors.device-forgotten: You forgot this device, so its files were closed.

ended.accountDevice: The other device is signed in to a Voltius account. Sign in here with the same account instead.
ended.bothGrouped: Both devices are already paired with other devices. Leave the group on one of them, then pair again.
ended.busy: The other device is already pairing with someone else. Try again in a moment.
ended.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Pairing is switched off. Open Pair a device again to retry.
ended.stopped: Pairing stopped. Open Pair a device again to retry.
